actors: shopper, including guests checking out and social-login users
preconditions: Shopper has attempted to sign in at least once

rules.reading: The account locks after 5 or more failed login attempts within a day.
The account unlocks automatically after 30 minutes; password reset is an alternative.
rules.sourcePhrase: it may unlock after some time or stay locked until I reset my password

rules.reading: All sign-in methods for the account are paused, with a helpful message.

numbers.name: Automatic unlock window
numbers.sourcePhrase: it may unlock after some time

outcomes: Account is temporarily paused with guidance on next steps
Shopper can sign in again after the window or via password reset
assumptions: Failed attempts are counted across devices for the same account
Rate limiting already caps rapid guessing before lockout
